about: Beauharnois is a city in Montérégie, Quebec, on the St. Lawrence River southwest of Montréal, known for the Beauharnois Canal and massive hydroelectric generating station. River industry, a small urban core, and South Shore farmland share the landscape toward Valleyfield and Châteauguay. About 14,000 people live in Beauharnois.
